objects.description: [CostaBricks](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0614) has used a number of API calls, including `VirtualAlloc`, `VirtualFree`, `LoadLibraryA`, `GetProcAddress`, and `ExitProcess`.(Citation: BlackBerry CostaRicto November 2020)
objects.description_fa: [CostaBricks](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0614) از تعدادی تماس API از جمله «VirtualAlloc»، «VirtualFree»، «LoadLibraryA»، «GetProcAddress» و «ExitProcess» استفاده کرده است.(Citation: BlackBerry CostaRicto November 2020)
